seed_ledger.name: AES Corp: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: Petersburg Generating Station: NO_DC_TIE. The coal to gas conversion of units 3 and 4 is justified on cost savings, not data center load. Gas comes by a new lateral of about 1 mile (about 1.6 km) to the Midwestern Gas Transmission system, reportedly built by DT Midstream, construction began August 2025. That is a short power plant lateral with no data center tie, so monitor only. The separate 2025 plan gas units at Petersburg for possible data center customers were handled by earlier runs (monitor, no site or gas supply named). Searches run: 2. Sources checked: Power magazine (one mile lateral to Midwestern), Indianapolis Business Journal (approval, cost case), search results for CDM Smith and Rigzone (contractor notices, no data center tie).

evidence.note: Petersburg units 3 and 4 coal to gas conversion with a roughly one mile lateral to Midwestern Gas Transmission; no data center reason given
Indiana regulator approval of the Petersburg conversion, framed on cost savings

seed_ledger.name: IDACORP Inc: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: Idaho Power 2025 IRP power stations (900 MW): NO_DC_TIE, a plan placeholder with no site or gas supply named. Peregrine Energy Center (430 MW, Elmore County, 2030): NO_DC_TIE, the certificate case (IPC-E-26-04) cites capacity need from load growth; company data center talk is company-wide, and a separate large data center plan on public land near Blacks Creek has no source linking it to Peregrine. No source names a pipeline sponsor or lateral for Peregrine. Searches run: 2. Sources checked: Idaho Power Peregrine page (no data center, no gas supply), Idaho regulator notice of application, IDACORP Q1 2026 call coverage (data centers named only in the general large load pipeline), East Idaho News and Pipeline and Gas Journal on a TerraVolt data center (different project).

evidence.note: Peregrine 430 MW simple cycle, Elmore County, June 2030, certificate under review; page names no data center and no gas supply line
